Class ScenarioEngineConfigSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioEngineConfigSectionBuilder
public class ScenarioEngineConfigSectionBuilder extends Object

Scenario Engine Config Section Builder

Modular UI builder for configuring simulation engine architecture:

  • Tier 1: 24 Permanent Core Physical Law Engines (Mass, thermodynamics, hydrology, energetics)
  • Tier 2: 68 Optional/Hypothetical Cliodynamic invalid input: '&' Macroeconomic Engines (Boserup, Turchin SDT, Smil, Ostrom)
  • Performance Optimizations invalid input: '&' Strict Determinism (Delegated to ScenarioPerformanceOptionsSection)
  • Dynamic Custom Engine Compiler invalid input: '&' Import/Export (Delegated to ScenarioCustomEngineHandler)

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
